label: Grammar and linguistics
definition: Sanskrit grammar, phonology, and linguistic-theoretical work.
inclusion: Panini/Patanjali studies; historical linguistics; sandhi/morphology; lexicography.
exclusion: Literary analysis of poetic diction alone.

label: Texts and philology
definition: Text-critical, editorial, and philological work on primary sources.
inclusion: Critical editions; manuscript-based readings; textual variants.
exclusion: Pure literary appreciation without textual apparatus.
examples: stemma of a Upanisad manuscript tradition

label: Religion and philosophy
definition: Darsana, religious practice, and doctrinal study.

label: History and culture
definition: Social, political, and cultural history of Sanskritic milieus.
inclusion: Court culture; historical sociology; cultural contact; area studies.
examples: Sanskrit court culture under a named dynasty

label: Manuscripts, epigraphy, and material culture
inclusion: Inscriptions; palm-leaf codicology; art-historical objects with text.

label: Digital and computational work
inclusion: DCS-style corpora; NLP pipelines; digital editions infrastructure; fonts and encodings.
exclusion: Manuscript description without a computational component.

label: Teaching and learning resources
inclusion: Textbooks; curricula; classroom method; guided reading groups.
exclusion: Research talks that merely happen to be given by teachers.

label: Institutions and field history
definition: History of the field of Indology/Sanskrit studies itself.
inclusion: Biography of scholars; institutional history; historiography of the discipline; collections and expeditions.
exclusion: Doctrinal history of the texts studied (see religion_philosophy).
examples: a history of a named Indological society

label: Other
definition: A recognizable scholarly topic not covered by the above axes.
inclusion: Any coherent topic outside the other labels.
exclusion: Anything that instead fits an existing label; items with no topic at all (see not_applicable); items whose topic cannot be read (see unknown).

label: Unknown
definition: Insufficient evidence to assign a topic; the item may well have one.
exclusion: Items where a topic could be determined; items that demonstrably carry no intellectual content (see not_applicable).

label: Not applicable
definition: The item demonstrably does no intellectual-content work at all, so no topic label can apply.
inclusion: Pure greetings; bare housekeeping/moderation notices; content-free social exchange.
exclusion: Items with a readable topic; items whose topic is merely unreadable (see unknown); coherent off-axis topics (see other).
examples: a bare New Year greeting with no scholarly content
